description: This file is a test script for verifying cherry-pick operations in Git, including handling of empty commits, commit messages, and various options related to cherry-pick behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success. Takes a description string and a command block.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that the command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks that the output contains a specific pattern.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or simulates time passing.

methods.name: test_commit_message
methods.description: Verifies the commit message of the current HEAD.
